title: homalocalyx coarctatus
intro: Homalocalyx coarctatus, commonly known as the Tasmanian tea tree, is a flowering plant native to Australia. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Homalocalyx coarctatus include wound healing, antifungal, and antiseptic properties, making it useful for treating skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of Homalocalyx coarctatus include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
